beats.say: Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or for the first time.
Thirty players were nominated for the men's award alone.
That's more nominees than you could fit in a school bus.
The ceremony was held at the London Palladium on Tuesday 26 October.
Kane's win marks a historic moment for English football.
His triumph shows the global impact of his talent.
Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or for the first time.
